+def test_release_returns_reserved_stock_to_available():
+    inv = Inventory()
+    inv.receive("A", 10)
+    inv.reserve("A", 4)

+    assert inv.reserved("A") == 1

+    inv.reserve("A", 4)

+    with pytest.raises(ShopError):

+
+    assert inv.on_hand("A") == 10
+    assert inv.reserved("A") == 4
+

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("sku, qty", [("A", 3), ("B", 1)])
+def test_cannot_release_more_than_reserved_or_unreserved_stock(sku, qty):
+    inv = Inventory()
+    inv.receive("A", 10)
+    inv.reserve("A", 2)
+
+    with pytest.raises(ShopError):

+
